name: Lobster Release
description: Release center for Godot build, patch, rollback, and approval workflows.

defaultProjectKey.label: Default Project Key
defaultProjectKey.help: Used when tool or HTTP calls omit projectKey.

projects.label: Project Policies
projects.help: Optional per-project policy map for environment/channel isolation, gray rollout defaults, rollout monitoring and circuit-breaker policy, region or audience dimensions, scheduled builds, and smoke workflows.

defaultEnvironment.label: Default Environment
defaultEnvironment.help: Default environment used for release creation and CI callbacks.

defaultChannel.label: Default Channel
defaultChannel.help: Default release channel used for release creation and CI callbacks.

routePrefix.label: Route Prefix
routePrefix.help: HTTP prefix for plugin-owned API endpoints.

ciRoutePrefix.label: CI Route Prefix
ciRoutePrefix.help: HTTP prefix compatible with existing Jenkins lobster scripts.

notifierSessionKey.label: Notifier Session Key
notifierSessionKey.help: Optional fixed notifier agent session key. Can be used as a bound delivery surface without configuring notifierChannel/notifierTarget.

notifierChannel.label: Notifier Channel
notifierChannel.help: Optional explicit outbound channel used by the notifier agent when you want lobster-release to provide a direct target.

notifierTarget.label: Notifier Target
notifierTarget.help: Optional explicit outbound target used by the notifier agent. Leave empty when notifierSessionKey already points at a bound agent session.

notifierAccountId.label: Notifier Account ID
notifierAccountId.help: Optional channel account id used for notifier deliveries.

publicBaseUrl.label: Public Base URL
publicBaseUrl.help: Optional public base URL used to derive manifest and artifact URLs.

callbackToken.label: Callback Token
callbackToken.help: Shared secret for Jenkins callback HMAC verification.

ciApiKey.label: CI API Key
ciApiKey.help: API key expected from Jenkins X-Lobster-Key header.

ciApiSecret.label: CI API Secret
ciApiSecret.help: Shared secret used to verify Jenkins X-Lobster-Signature.

jenkinsBaseUrl.label: Jenkins Base URL
jenkinsBaseUrl.help: Optional Jenkins base URL for build trigger.

jenkinsJob.label: Jenkins Job
jenkinsJob.help: Default Jenkins job name for release builds.

jenkinsLobsterApiKeyCredentialsId.label: Jenkins Lobster Key Cred ID
jenkinsLobsterApiKeyCredentialsId.help: Optional Jenkins Secret Text credentials ID for LOBSTER_API_KEY.

jenkinsLobsterApiSecretCredentialsId.label: Jenkins Lobster Secret Cred ID
jenkinsLobsterApiSecretCredentialsId.help: Optional Jenkins Secret Text credentials ID for LOBSTER_API_SECRET.

jenkinsAndroidKeystoreBase64CredentialsI.label: Android Keystore Base64 Cred ID
jenkinsAndroidKeystoreBase64CredentialsI.help: Optional Jenkins Secret Text credentials ID for ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64.

jenkinsAndroidKeystoreAliasCredentialsId.label: Android Keystore Alias Cred ID
jenkinsAndroidKeystoreAliasCredentialsId.help: Optional Jenkins Secret Text credentials ID for ANDROID_KEYSTORE_ALIAS.

jenkinsAndroidKeystorePasswordCredential.label: Android Keystore Password Cred ID
jenkinsAndroidKeystorePasswordCredential.help: Optional Jenkins Secret Text credentials ID for ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD.

uploadDestinationDir.label: Upload Destination Dir
uploadDestinationDir.help: Optional filesystem path where Jenkins copies exported artifacts before the publish callback.

uploadBaseUrl.label: Upload Base URL
uploadBaseUrl.help: Optional base URL prefixed onto uploaded artifact relative paths.

artifactRetentionDays.label: Artifact Retention Days
artifactRetentionDays.help: Retention window for cleaning non-protected artifact files and manifests.

auditRetentionDays.label: Audit Retention Days
auditRetentionDays.help: Retention window for old event, idempotency, and delivered notification records.

maintenanceKeepStableCount.label: Keep Stable Releases
maintenanceKeepStableCount.help: Minimum number of latest stable releases preserved per channel during maintenance.
